propositions: When signing_key is configured but author_id is unresolvable and require_authenticated is off (default), _apply_authorship returns silently without logging the skipped signature, hiding unsigned writes.

fsck's authorship tally is summed store-wide into a single uncounted advisory line with no per-env breakdown, making it invisible when one env writes 0% signed events behind another env's healthy volume.

fsck must emit a counted UNSIGNED_ENV issue for any env_id that has at least one event and either zero signed events or all events authored Unknown/absent, gated to fire only when the store adopted signing and that env wrote at or after the earliest signed event.

_apply_authorship must emit a logger.warning when signing is skipped for lack of resolvable identity or missing signing_key, naming the event uuid, ticket, and which input was missing, without causing writes to fail.
